metric: Invar materials patents for metal masks
source: DNP Group IR Day Q&A, 11 July 2024
author: Dai Nippon Printing
title: DNP Group IR Day Q&A summary
notes: DNP says it is competitive because of patents for invar materials and that they will not expire for the foreseeable future. Masks are jigs, so sales depend on the number of product types, not on panel units. The Q&A discusses a +8.3 percent metal-mask sales CAGR shown on page 7 of the presentation. DNP does not expect mask-free methods to replace metal masks immediately. The wording is invar, not FeNi36, and no foil gauge is given.
